products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Optional fingerprint unlock, built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. Nothing ever shows up in gallery apps or file managers. NEW in v1.1.0: disguise the app itself — switch its launcher name and icon to Calculator, Notes or Gallery, or add a custom home-screen shortcut with any name and picture.
